name: design-with-apple-hig
description: Design and review Apple-platform interfaces using current HIG sources and evidence-backed validation.

interface.shortDescription: Design and validate Apple interfaces from primary sources
interface.longDescription: Apply current Apple Human Interface Guidelines across Apple platforms, preserve source scope and wording strength, and verify build, rendering, accessibility and input behavior. Includes the original evidence-first skill and a standalone Zed URL-import edition.
defaultPrompt: Review this Apple app with current HIG evidence and explicit validation limits.
